hypothesis: A bounded three-completed-bar retest can separate some immediate v1 breakout entries from persistent setups using only the recorded v1 onset and subsequent completed one-minute bars, but it must improve resolved after-friction outcomes rather than merely reduce entry count or delay execution.
decision: Keep the active v14 runtime unchanged while BTC, ETH, and SOL remain open and protected. Preserve the v2 retest as report-only: the causal replay resolves all seven observed v1 onsets and confirms three, but only one confirmed lifecycle is closed and it lost, while the two other confirmed lifecycles remain open. The retest would have expired the two routed aligned entries that later lost and one already-withheld SOL onset, but its three confirmations occurred after short reference prices worsened by a mean 7.92 bps. Do not infer economic improvement, activate the retest, change sizing, or restart the backend from this prefix. Re-evaluate after the three open lifecycles resolve and compare actual v1 outcomes with confirmation timing, attainable fills, fees, funding, MFE, MAE, and missed paths.
falsifier: The technical replay is falsified by any mismatch between its seven onset identities, recorded v1 routes, completed-bar sequence, or immutable ledger snapshot. The economic hypothesis is weakened if confirmed setups remain net negative after attainable delayed fills and friction, or if expired setups outperform confirmed setups; it is strengthened only by a larger prospective, non-overlapping, bidirectional sample in which confirmation improves after-friction expectancy and drawdown without concentrating results in one symbol or one correlated burst.
limitations: BTC, ETH, and SOL remain open, so three lifecycle outcomes, marked PnL, MFE, MAE, funding, and exit attribution can still change.
Only seven v1 onsets exist; four belong to one correlated cross-asset burst and every routed entry is short.
The replay reuses recorded v1 onset metrics and completed one-minute bars; it does not recompute the classifier, model private IOC fills, or claim executable counterfactual PnL.
A worse delayed reference price is not identical to realized slippage, but it establishes that confirmation does not provide a free timing improvement.
The two expired routed entries that later lost and the one confirmed entry that later lost are too few and too dependent to estimate expectancy.
No live strategy, position, order, stop, sizing policy, backend process, checkpoint process, or portfolio configuration changed as a result of this revision.
